issue_context.title: StatefulSet: detailed revision view return a revisions list
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please use this template while reporting a bug and provide as much info as possible. Not doing so may result in your bug not being addressed in a timely manner. Thanks!

If the matter is security related, please disclose it privately via https://kubernetes.io/security/
-->


**What happened**:
build kubectl
```
[user@localhost kubernetes-master]# make kubectl
```
when I view the statefulset with a revision, it return a list of the statefulset revisions
```
[user@localhost kubernetes-master]# _output/bin/kubectl rollout history statefulset xxx --revision=1
statefulset.apps/xxx with revision #1
REVISION
1
```

**What you expected to happen**:
when I view the statefulset with a revision, it return the pod template just like deployment and daemonset
```
[user@localhost kubernetes-master]#  _output/bin/kubectl rollout history statefulset xxx --revision=1
statefulset.apps/xxx with revision #1
Pod Template:
  Labels:
        app=xxx
        name=xxx
        version=1.0.0
  Containers:
   rabbitmq:
    Image:      xxxx
    Ports:      8080/TCP
    Host Ports: 0/TCP, 0/TCP
```
